hierarchy_composition.evidence: desktop_fold.png squint: eye hits the 6fr/36rem mosaic first (cyan sky, white lab benches), then the 44px 700 h1, then the filled Request a quote. saturate(.58) plus tank overlay muted rust vs last round, but lab panes have no overlay, so collage luminance still beats type. Uses is a 1-col bordered list; Who is one column with Chairman kicker and h2 Binay Chandra Jha. tablet_full.png is one pane; hero .btn is display:none below 1023px.
strengths: Staggered straight mosaic cuts at three heights, not one chevron, with sparse DNA in the gutters
Section order is a buyer argument, not a SaaS template
Hero pairs a filled Request a quote with a quieter See specification text link

issues.problem: Collage still wins the squint. Tank overlay at 22% and saturate(.58) quieted rust, but lab panes stay high-key and the 36rem/6fr mass out-luminances the 44px h1.
issues.fix: Set .pane.tank::after to background:rgba(1,32,86,.4). Add .pane:not(.tank)::after with background:rgba(1,32,86,.22). Set .shot .pane img filter to saturate(.45) brightness(.86). At min-width:1024px set .mosaic{height:28rem}.

issues.problem: .uses max-width:36ch leaves the 6fr column mostly empty next to a 2.4rem h2.
issues.fix: Remove max-width on .uses so the three bordered rows fill the 6fr column.

issues.problem: Top-right lab pipes and bottom-middle red tank read as leftover shards.
issues.fix: Set col 3 first pane clip-path to polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% 56%,0 48%). Set col 2 last pane clip-path to polygon(0 70%,100% 76%,100% 100%,0 100%).
